resources.string: Sync saved PSK and WEP networks with this Google account. Hidden, temporary, disabled, enterprise and SAE networks are excluded. Existing networks created by another app are kept when they conflict.
This system image does not provide the privileged Wi-Fi access required for sync.
Android requires precise location permission to read saved Wi-Fi networks. Allow precise location to continue. Sync still requires your separate approval.
Turn on Location in Android settings to let Wi-Fi sync read saved networks.
Android is blocking Wi-Fi access. Check the app’s location permission and allow background access if you want scheduled sync.
Wi-Fi access changed. Check location permission and the Location setting, then try again.

Upload eligible saved Wi-Fi names, passwords and metered settings to this account, and add saved account networks to this device? Later edits and removals sync for networks managed by this feature. Existing conflicting networks are kept for review.

A previous change may already have reached Google or this device. Refresh first reconciles observed results. Authorize another attempt only where the original account, vault and previous network configuration still match?

Pause Wi-Fi sync and discard its local history and pending recovery records? Previous changes may already have reached Google or this device. Saved device and account networks stay in place. Enabling again starts a new merge.
